title: Shipping Fee Assessment across a Customer's Tailwise Autoship Shipments
content:
Tailwise Autoship assesses the standard shipping fee across the customer's whole Autoship portfolio for one scheduled ship date, and charges surcharges and packaging fees shipment by shipment.

## Assessment rule

1. **Same-day subtotal.** For one scheduled ship date, the same-day subtotal is the sum of the merchandise subtotals of every scheduled shipment charged to the customer with that scheduled ship date, across all of the customer's subscriptions.
2. **Threshold met.** When the same-day subtotal is at least the free-shipping threshold of every program shipping that day, no standard shipping fee is charged on any of those shipments.
3. **Threshold not met.** Otherwise one standard shipping fee is charged, on the shipment with the highest standard fee among them, and 0.00 on the others.
4. **Ship-now.** A ship-now shipment is assessed on its own merchandise subtotal.
5. **Tailwise Plus.** A customer whose Tailwise Plus membership is in status active pays no standard shipping fee on any Autoship shipment, regardless of subtotal. Pals Rewards tiers without a paid membership do not change shipping.
6. **Heavy-item surcharge.** The program's heavy-item surcharge is charged for every unit whose shipping weight is at least the program's heavy-item weight: the quantity multiplied by the surcharge, rounded to the cent.
7. **Packaging fee.** The insulated packaging fee of cold-chain programs is charged on every shipment.
8. **Never waived.** The heavy-item surcharge and the packaging fee are never waived by the threshold or by membership.

## Derived points

- Because the packaging fee belongs to cold-chain programs, a program that does not ship refrigerated or frozen charges no packaging fee, whatever figure its tariff line shows.
- Rule 2 needs the same-day subtotal to reach the highest threshold among the programs shipping that day.

## Worked example (hypothetical shipments on one scheduled ship date, no Tailwise Plus)

| Shipment | Program | Threshold | Standard fee | Merchandise subtotal |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | Autoship Everyday | 49.00 | 4.95 | 30.00 |
| B | Autoship Fresh & Frozen | 99.00 | 9.95 | 50.00 |

Same-day subtotal: 80.00 USD. It reaches the 49.00 threshold but not the 99.00 threshold, so rule 2 is not met. One standard fee is charged: 9.95 USD on shipment B, the higher standard fee, and 0.00 on shipment A. Had shipment A been 49.00 USD instead, the same-day subtotal would be 99.00 USD and no standard fee would be charged on either.

**Heavy units.** Two units of 40 lb on Autoship Everyday (surcharge 6.99 USD) carry a surcharge of 13.98 USD, charged even when no standard fee applies.
